correctness.rationale: Nonzero proper ideals correspond to nonempty proper supports and adjacency is disjointness. Each co-singleton support has exactly one neighbor, its complementary singleton, forcing all r singleton supports into every total dominating set. Those singletons form a dominating clique, giving uniqueness. Paired domination follows from parity; in odd rank any one extra support of size at least two can be paired to a missing-coordinate singleton, and every minimum paired set has exactly one such extra. Fresh enumeration for r=2 through 5 reproduced unique total minima and paired minimum-set counts 1,3,1,25.

final_claim: For a direct product of r at least two fields, the annihilating-ideal graph has a unique minimum total dominating set, the coordinate minimal ideals; the paired minimum is r for even r and r+1 for odd r, with the same unique set in even rank and exactly \(2^r-r-2\) minimum paired sets in odd rank.
